weekly_calendar: Monday-Sunday; SQLDATE event week; unique GLOBALEVENTID across exports; ActionGeo_CountryCode=IS; roots 18/19
snapshots: Rows of count_vintages are origins; columns are event weeks; use only columns <= origin; export_day < origin Monday +7d. Duplicates removed before aggregation.
news: Mean AvgTone/GoldsteinScale, std GoldsteinScale, volume, unique domains, root counts: own-week records available by issue; news_volume_change_wow denominator has one-week grace.
issue: Following Monday 12:00 UTC, assumed publisher schedule; no started-week archives.
truth_2024: All fetched archives through 2025-01-05; CV early truth panel row166, late truth row195.

ecb.source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates
ecb.unit: ILS per USD = (ILS per EUR) / (USD per EUR)
ecb.availability_policy: Use observations dated at least 7 days before issue date.
ecb.revision_limitation: Current historical snapshot, not original vintages; rare corrections cannot be ruled out.

truth_7d: Each target week with 7-day grace; own or grace week missing -> NaN.
